import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import bootstrap

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('/data/requirements_engineering_for_ML-enabled_systems.csv')

# Define the columns related to documentation formats
documentation_columns = [
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Vision_Document',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Requirements_Lists',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Goal_Models',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Use_Case_Models',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Prototypes',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_User_Stories',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_BDD_Scenarios',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_MLCanvas',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Notebooks',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Data_Models',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Others'
]

# Count the frequency of each documentation format
documentation_counts = df[documentation_columns].sum()

# Perform a bootstrap analysis to determine the most frequently used documentation format
bootstrap_result = bootstrap((documentation_counts,), np.mean, confidence_level=0.95)

# Determine the most frequently used documentation format
most_frequent_documentation = documentation_counts.idxmax()
most_frequent_count = documentation_counts.max()
